name: Peñaranda de Bracamonte (Spain)
description: Purple field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Peñaranda de Bracamonte (fleurs-de-lis on blue within a cartouche of scrolls).
history: Municipal flag of Peñaranda de Bracamonte; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Peñaranda de Bracamonte arms — fleurs-de-lis on blue within a cartouche of scrolls
fleurs-de-lis, scrolls and crown of the arms
